integrity: Analytical Taylor-jet proof and explicit positive-semidefinite noise matrix; symbolic and numerical reproduction are supplementary to proof.
scientific_limitations: Exact continuous tangent-projected, zero-drift Lyapunov prediction with positive-semidefinite constant noise; specifically simple-spectrum positive diagonal data and ranks one and two in dimension three. No assertion about a discretized BUG step, Kalman observation correction, or error norms. Independent publication-priority validation has not been performed.
title: Rank growth need not order dynamical low-rank covariance predictions
